A_historical.determinism: no randomness; sorted attack-type order and the frozen SHA-256 benign entity hash from p1_dataset.negative_fold_of
A_historical.rule: positives: test fold = index of their attack_type in the sorted type list; negatives: test fold = frozen negative_fold_of(entity_key, 5); train = the whole population minus the test fold
A_historical.title: Protocol A — historical baseline (leave-one-attack-type-out)

B_entity_disjoint.determinism: no randomness; sorted entity order and the frozen SHA-256 benign entity hash
B_entity_disjoint.rule: positives: test fold = index of their entity_key in the sorted attack entity list; negatives: test fold = negative_fold_of(entity_key, 9); train = the whole population minus the test fold
B_entity_disjoint.title: Protocol B — entity-disjoint (leave-one-attack-entity-out)

C_episode_disjoint_botnet_ares.determinism: no randomness; round-robin over sorted episodes into 5 folds over lexicographically sorted episode_id
C_episode_disjoint_botnet_ares.rule: botnet/ares positives: test fold = sorted episode index modulo 5; positives of every other family are always training rows; negatives: test fold = negative_fold_of(entity_key, 5)
C_episode_disjoint_botnet_ares.title: Protocol C — episode-disjoint inside botnet/ares

C_episode_disjoint_brute_force_ssh_patat.determinism: no randomness; leave-one-episode-out over lexicographically sorted episode_id
C_episode_disjoint_brute_force_ssh_patat.rule: brute_force/ssh_patator positives: test fold = sorted episode index modulo 9; positives of every other family are always training rows; negatives: test fold = negative_fold_of(entity_key, 9)
C_episode_disjoint_brute_force_ssh_patat.title: Protocol C — episode-disjoint inside brute_force/ssh_patator

D_zero_day_ares.determinism: no randomness; identical construction to protocol A fold 0
D_zero_day_ares.rule: test = all botnet/ares windows plus the benign entities whose frozen negative_fold_of(entity_key, 5) equals 0; train = everything else, which contains no Ares window
D_zero_day_ares.title: Protocol D — zero-day, leave-Ares-out
